verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible left-to-right order: logo, headline, SAVE badge, body, CTA, product at the right edge. Flaws: the product is a tiny sliver jammed against the right edge and its label is unreadable; the badge floats in the gap between the headline and the body copy, away from the product; the body copy is small; the logo is tiny. B has a clearly broken order and brand treatment: the SAVE badge sits left of the headline and touches the edge. The logo is enlarged to a big circle in the middle that competes with the headline, and it sits between the product and the copy. The product is tiny and cramped beside the logo. The body copy is wrapped into a narrow column crammed against the CTA, and the headline wraps to an orphaned 'repeat'. B is more chaotic overall.
